evidence.title: YYLO src/templates/services/codex.py

evidence.title: YYLO src/templates/services/gemini.py

evidence.title: YYLO src/templates/wiki/controller/parallel_runner_and_spec_review.md

evidence.finding: The shipped controller instructions distinguish generic ordered workflows, a terminal orchestrator, managed worker/reviewer launch scripts and deterministic task/merge commands.
